mapper.sql:
FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON o.kind = 'PURCHASE' AND sp.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer cu ON o.kind = 'SALES' AND cu.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = o.salesman_id WHERE o.kind = #{kind} AND o.status IN #{s} AND o.order_date >= #{begin} AND o.order_date <= #{end}
AND (sp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partner}, '%') OR sp.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partner}, '%') OR cu.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partner}, '%') OR cu.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partner}, '%'))
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{material}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{material}, '%'))
AND su.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{salesman}, '%')
COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) AS qty, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount * o.exchange_rate), 0) AS amount

choose.when:
SELECT o.partner_id AS group_id, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code) AS group_code, COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) AS group_name,
GROUP BY o.partner_id, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code), COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) ORDER BY SUM(i.amount * o.exchange_rate) DESC, group_id

SELECT o.salesman_id AS group_id, su.nickname AS group_name,
GROUP BY o.salesman_id, su.nickname ORDER BY SUM(i.amount * o.exchange_rate) DESC, group_id

SELECT i.material_id AS group_id, m.code AS group_code, m.name AS group_name, m.unit AS unit,
GROUP BY i.material_id, m.code, m.name, m.unit ORDER BY SUM(i.amount * o.exchange_rate) DESC, group_id
choose.otherwise:
SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS year_no, MONTH(o.order_date) AS month_no,
GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date) ORDER BY year_no, month_no
